refinement_policy: One child is a scoped proposed proof obligation, not an independently accepted new original fine ID. Historical completed proper subfeatures are excluded from this plan.

leaves.scope: A genuine four-chain with original direction e
leaves.task: Classify the five other squares by their complete projected intervals and exact endpoint-gap relationships
leaves.done_when: A genuine four-plus-three paired gap is derived or an explicit non-chain alternative is retained, including ties

leaves.scope: A 3+2 allocation beside a four-chain with an upper T-shaped triple
leaves.task: Derive an actual full-square obstruction or exact pocket for the T's transverse cap
leaves.done_when: The eight-square cross is admitted as a negative control; no false three-chain assertion

leaves.scope: The same non-chain 3+2 allocation and the two actual squares on the opposite side
leaves.task: Show that the T-side configuration and opposite-side squares cannot jointly fit below Q
leaves.done_when: All five distinct actual completion squares and mutual nonoverlap participate in the same inequality

leaves.scope: Every remaining pair of arbitrarily oriented completion squares
leaves.task: Use a legal actual separating axis for each needed pair, including oblique and endpoint owners
leaves.done_when: No step assumes one globally coordinate-separating frame

leaves.scope: An unloaded branching vertex with full original positive force and torque star
leaves.task: Express the defect between entering and leaving channel projected widths using actual original contact applications
leaves.done_when: Give a signed inequality retaining all incident chords and nonzero forces

leaves.scope: A turning branch with less than one full unit of channel width
leaves.task: Prove an actual central-sector occupancy or equivalent necessary geometric witness, instead of charging a fictitious set gap
leaves.done_when: The five-square cross satisfies the stated dichotomy

leaves.scope: Two or more turning or chorded vertices in one positive block
leaves.task: Show how center/annular defect charges compose without charging one physical square twice
leaves.done_when: A finite injective assignment or explicit joint inequality covers all branches

leaves.scope: A branching/chorded block with physical boundary marks and arbitrary outside degrees
leaves.task: Extend marked-cycle gap/arc accounting to its intact full graph and all actual contacts
leaves.done_when: No positive chord is deleted, and a drawing face is not used as an actual hole

leaves.scope: A short/chorded core with m<9 selected positive bodies
leaves.task: Derive actual barriers and route all 9−m remaining physical squares to their true complementary regions
leaves.done_when: One joint capacity theorem excludes the full nine-square completion, including zero-stress contacts

leaves.scope: Two distinct actual units with center norm below one
leaves.task: Couple their actual relative placement to the occupied inner-circle angular arcs of the other seven
leaves.done_when: A pair-dependent angular loss is proved; all-radii independent-profile relaxation witness is not falsely excluded

leaves.scope: Exactly three actual near-origin units and up to six remaining units
leaves.task: Prove an honest three-resource angular/center-sector inequality with original square intersections
leaves.done_when: The existing three-near and four-near capacity theorems apply at their exact strict distance thresholds

leaves.scope: A square whose center radial direction lies inside a proposed annular gap
leaves.task: Route its actual connected open inner-circle component, not merely its center direction
leaves.done_when: The entire actual component is in one certified complementary interval; multi-component exceptions retained

leaves.scope: An origin-containing articulation and an actual boundary-neighbor cut with nonpositive resultant pressure
leaves.task: Use the unchanged zero origin moment to identify a non-common-side opposite-moment witness pair
leaves.done_when: Prove the original witness-pair decomposition and its geometrically possible root-side options

leaves.scope: A genuine endblock whose original root contacts lie on two or more distinct sides
leaves.task: Prove an exact pressure/wrench cone for each physical root-side configuration
leaves.done_when: Handles endpoint normals and original means without transferring a common-side theorem

leaves.scope: A genuine cut with one or more physically circle-clear positive root neighbors
leaves.task: Keep their full original contact forces and determine the allowable resultant sign or exit
leaves.done_when: Does not identify physical circle-clear with zero selected circle multiplier

leaves.scope: An endblock with a positive circle load on a square not physically touching its articulation
leaves.task: Control its radial resultant using an actual physical path/cut and not an invented adjacency
leaves.done_when: Permits arbitrary internal chords and degrees while bounding the resultant projection

leaves.scope: An articulation root not containing O
leaves.task: Classify the root support/central access before invoking any origin-containing pressure lemma
leaves.done_when: Either excludes such a root or proves a separate correct wrench inequality

leaves.scope: Triangle plus a block of order five or larger sharing a root
leaves.task: Prove which physical boundary neighbors are forced by each real triangle tip and private loaded structure
leaves.done_when: Supports 3+5, 3+6 and 3+7 original two-block parents without assuming all loaded members touch H

leaves.scope: A full three-edge cut around an unloaded connected module with internal cycle rank at least two
leaves.task: Prove a physical incompatibility or finite topology/width restriction
leaves.done_when: No cyclic module is treated as a tree and all three original cut edges counted

leaves.scope: The five necessary three-port unicyclic (t,s) profiles that survive the proved |K|≤5 theorem
leaves.task: Derive actual endpoint/stress geometry and the joint nine-square completion obstruction
leaves.done_when: Original two exit-position classes in (1,1) both covered

leaves.scope: A one-exit-per-hub module satisfying the published 29/30 concentration estimate
leaves.task: Remove a whole residual topology without discarding arbitrarily small positive force coefficients
leaves.done_when: The excluded class is stated with true degrees and full original cut

leaves.scope: The selected planar physical stress body graph and its complete physical touching graph
leaves.task: Distinguish actual Jordan contact rings from topological drawing faces at every multibody junction
leaves.done_when: An actual whole-square routing theorem, not just a center label

leaves.scope: Exactly four full cut edges around an entirely unloaded unicyclic module
leaves.task: Bound internal subdivided runs and original cut forces without dropping any of four exits
leaves.done_when: Either exclude a named topology or reduce to a finite original four-port physical profile

leaves.scope: Exactly four full cut edges around a loaded-free module with cycle rank at least two
leaves.task: Derive one full-cut support/force inequality that retains both cycles and arbitrary chords
leaves.done_when: Excludes a precisely characterized multi-cycle contact topology

leaves.scope: An unloaded module with at least five full cut edges among nine actual squares
leaves.task: Prove a nine-square center/width obstruction for the original full cut, without imposing a tree hypothesis
leaves.done_when: A finite cut-size/branch-rank restriction with all original exits accounted
